question: What is the maximum number of consecutive working days I can take in one leave application without HOD approval?
expected_answer: 10 consecutive working days (effective 1 Oct 2026). Longer needs HOD + HR approval.
notes: Trap: Handbook 2026 says 7, Handbook 2024 says 5. Correct answer must use the memo.

question: How many days of annual leave does a Grade M2 manager with 6 years of service get?
expected_answer: 22 days per year.

question: How many annual leave days does a new Executive (E1) with 1 year of service get?
expected_answer: 14 days per year.

question: How many days of annual leave can I carry forward, and by when must I use leave carried forward from 2026?
expected_answer: Up to 5 days; 2026 balances can be used until 30 April 2027 (normally 31 March).
notes: Trap: Handbook 2024 says 8 days by 30 June.

question: How far in advance must I apply for 5 days of annual leave?
expected_answer: At least 14 calendar days in advance (leave of more than 3 working days).

question: How many days a week must I work from the office, and which days?
expected_answer: Minimum 3 days: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

question: What are the core working hours?
expected_answer: 10:00 to 16:00 (standard hours 9:00–18:00, Mon–Fri).

question: What is the yearly limit for outpatient medical claims?
expected_answer: RM 1,500 per calendar year (dental RM 500).

question: What is the notice period for a manager (M grade) who resigns?
expected_answer: 2 months.

question: Can I work remotely from overseas, and for how long?
expected_answer: Yes, up to 20 working days per calendar year with HOD and HR approval. But Bank Teratai systems may not be accessed from outside Malaysia.

question: How many days of paternity leave do employees get?
expected_answer: 7 consecutive days.

question: What is the mileage claim rate for using my own car?
expected_answer: RM 0.70 per km, plus toll and parking with receipts.

question: What is the hotel limit per night for a business trip to Penang?
expected_answer: RM 350 per night.

question: Can a Senior (S2) engineer fly business class to London?
expected_answer: No. Business class is only for flights over 6 hours AND for M grades and above; S2 flies economy.

question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
expected_answer: Within 30 days of the expense; claims older than 60 days are rejected.

question: Who needs to approve a claim of RM 2,500?
expected_answer: Both the HOD and Finance (claims over RM 2,000).

question: What is the minimum password length?
expected_answer: 14 characters, stored in Bitwarden; MFA is mandatory.

question: Can I paste Bank Teratai customer data into ChatGPT on my personal account to summarise it?
expected_answer: No. Client production data is Restricted and may only be used with approved AI tools (company Claude workspace, company GitHub Copilot); personal AI accounts are never approved for client data.

question: I clicked a phishing link. Who do I report it to and how quickly?
expected_answer: Email security@serimaju.example within 1 hour; outside office hours also call IT on-call at ext. 2222.

question: Within how many hours must Bank Teratai be notified of a security incident?
expected_answer: 2 hours (after internal reporting to Security within 1 hour).

question: What do I need before visiting the Pelita Precision factory?
expected_answer: Book at least 3 working days ahead through the account manager (Arjun Pillai), complete a safety induction, and wear safety boots and a high-visibility vest. No USB drives on the OT network.

question: Where must Gemilang Capital data be hosted?
expected_answer: Malaysia or Singapore.

question: Who is the account manager for Gemilang Capital, and who does she report to?
expected_answer: Zainab Yusof; she reports to Nurul Huda, Client Delivery Director.

question: Who does the Finance team report to?
expected_answer: Finance Manager Kumar Selvam, who reports to CFO Hafiz Osman.

question: Who is the Head of Security and which executive do they report to?
expected_answer: Jason Wong; reports to CTO Daniel Lim.

When does the Gemilang Capital contract end?
